title: Customer observations and prior-vehicle comparisons
summary: This topic is dominated by incomplete customer observations and prior-vehicle references, with a few positive comments about vehicle size, connected navigation, and BEV quietness.

positive.summary: Positive remarks mention satisfaction with the vehicle's large size, the ability to send destinations from a phone to the car, and the quiet cabin experience in the electric version.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are mostly partial customer notes about prior vehicles, appointments, design, maneuverability, interior tightness, settings, and one-off events without enough context to infer sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are incomplete or lack enough context to determine sentiment.
The topic mixes several loosely related subjects, including prior-vehicle comparisons, service scheduling, design comments, usability notes, and isolated incidents.
Examples are insufficient to identify a single consistent product area beyond general customer observations.
